result.reasoning_summary: Test-only repair patch that adds three parameterized test cases to close documented FW-DSPM-005 denial boundaries: (1) post-expiry now=201 → ACTION_TICKET_DENIED, (2) malformed target_ref with whitespace → PROPOSAL_REF_INVALID, (3) malformed policy_decision_ref with trailing slash → PROPOSAL_REF_INVALID. All cases use the existing test function pattern, employ correct error codes, and directly address stated gaps. SWARM_STATUS and WORK_QUEUE updated to reflect REPAIR state. No runtime behavior changes. Narrow, deterministic, focused scope.
